complete_mirror_norm_proof: The full lattice is unimodular because theta-1 is a unit and the Niemeier block is unimodular. For primitive r its pairing ideal is O, so reflection integrality q(r)|2I(r) gives (q)|(2). The polynomial of theta is irreducible modulo 2, hence (2) is inert and the only norm ideals are O and (2). The Minkowski bound 14/9 proves class number one; the units -1, theta, theta^2-2 have full signature rank, so every totally positive unit is a square. Canonical positive norms are 1,2.
